name: Disposable & Reusable Elastic Food Covers | Transparent Bowl & Plate Covers | Stretchable Dustproof Food Storage Covers | Kitchen Freshness Protector | 100Pcs
description:
Keep your food covered, clean, and protected with these 100Pcs Elastic Food Covers. Made from transparent and flexible PE material, these disposable and reusable covers feature an elastic edge that stretches around different bowls, plates, containers, and other food items for a convenient fit. The transparent design lets you see the food without removing the cover, while the elastic seal helps protect food from dust, insects, odors, and outside contaminants. Lightweight and easy to use, these covers are ideal for everyday kitchen storage, parties, picnics, family gatherings, and outdoor meals.

Key Features
Pack of 100 disposable and reusable food covers
Transparent design for easy visibility of covered food
Stretchable elastic edge provides a secure fit
Suitable for different sizes of bowls, plates, and containers
Helps protect food from dust, insects, and outside contaminants
Waterproof and flexible PE material
Easy to put on and remove
Can be reused when properly cleaned and maintained
Convenient alternative to traditional plastic wrap
Ideal for kitchen, parties, picnics, BBQs, and outdoor use

Product Specifications
Product Type: Elastic Food Bowl Cover
Material: PE Plastic
Color: Transparent
Quantity: 100 Pieces
Design: Elastic Stretchable Edge
Features: Waterproof, Dustproof & Flexible
Usage: Food Storage & Covering
Application: Bowls, Plates, Containers & Food Items

How to Use
Select a suitable food cover according to the size of the bowl or container
Stretch the elastic edge gently
Place the cover over the bowl, plate, or container
Ensure the elastic edge fits securely around the sides
Remove the cover when serving or accessing the food
If reusable, clean and dry properly before the next use

Material / Composition
Transparent PE Plastic Film
Elastic Stretchable Edging

Safety Information
Use only for covering and storing suitable food items
Keep away from direct flame and high heat
Do not place directly on hot cookware
Do not use in an oven or microwave unless specifically stated on the product packaging
Keep unused covers away from children
For reusable use, clean and dry thoroughly before reuse

Package Includes
100 × Elastic Food Covers
